description: This file defines a Helper class 'Handler' within the PhpSpreadsheet namespace, containing utility methods related to error handling, warnings, deprecation, and timezone settings.

classes.name: Handler
classes.description: A helper class providing static methods for handling errors, warnings, deprecation notices, and timezone configuration.

methods.name: suppressed
methods.description: Returns a boolean indicating if a suppressed error was triggered.

methods.name: deprecated
methods.description: Returns a string representation of a hexadecimal value converted to decimal, illustrating deprecated features.

methods.name: notice
methods.description: Sets the default timezone to the given value.

methods.name: warning
methods.description: Checks for the existence of a file by trying to read its contents; always returns true unless the file does not exist.
